patch.value: Regression: governance dedupe audit again rejects the explicit all-lifecycle status sentinel

In the current 2026.8.1 checkout, pm dedupe-audit --mode title_exact --status all --limit 10000 --json exits invalid_argument_value even though closed canonical issue pm-mp49 records explicit --status all support as implemented and verified. Omitting --status considers all 2,263 items, so behavior, documentation, recovery guidance, and the closed contract have drifted apart. This is a recurrence linked to pm-mp49, not a duplicate of its historical delivery.

Explicit --status all succeeds and considers the same all-lifecycle candidate set as an omitted status filter; result metadata truthfully records the explicit all sentinel; help, action contracts, docs, completion metadata, SDK/package handler, focused tests, and packed installed-consumer behavior agree; configured custom statuses remain accepted and invalid statuses still fail with the declared domain; a regression gate prevents the package-owned parser from drifting from the shared lifecycle-filter contract
Restore one explicit, contract-backed all-lifecycle duplicate-scan grammar across core and package-owned surfaces
Agents can follow the repository-required duplicate-prevention workflow without memorizing an undocumented omission workaround
Removes a live contradiction between the CLI, docs, recovery text, and immutable completion evidence
All-status duplicate sweeps are explicit, portable, tested, and stable
The mandated all-status inventory reproduced the regression before any new tracker item was created
pm 2026.8.1 built from current main with active pm-governance-audit package
Run pm dedupe-audit --mode title_exact --status all --limit 10000 --json; compare with the same command omitting --status.
Both invocations consider all lifecycle states; the explicit invocation reports filters.status=all.
The explicit invocation exits code 2 because all is rejected; omission succeeds across 2,263 items.
Agents following AGENTS.md and docs cannot express the required all-status duplicate scan explicitly and receive contradictory recovery guidance.
